description: This file defines the RequestInterface interface within the PSR HTTP Message standard, representing an outgoing client-side HTTP request with methods for request target, method, URI, and related properties.

classes.name: RequestInterface
classes.description: An interface extending MessageInterface, representing an immutable HTTP request with methods to get and set request target, method, and URI.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the message's request target, defaulting to "/" if none is set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, maintaining immutability.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method, case-sensitive.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI instance associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
